A2P SMS, MMS and RCS Connectivity
Trusted by Global Brands
and Industry Leaders
If you're looking to launch RCS the right way, you've come to the RCS leader.
RCS 
has arrived, and Vibes has opened the doors to messaging that provides an interactive, engaging, app-quality experience (without the app!). 
Text 
RCS
 to 
84237
 to see it in action!
Vibes is actively launching hundreds of RCS agents for brands, businesses and developers
 
right now. With our direct carrier connections, provisioning speed and compliance expertise, we have 
the
 playbook ready for you to get started with this next chapter in digital messaging. 
Let's talk!
Learn More About RCS
Launch Now With RCS Studio
Your mobile database is an asset. It's time to 
treat it like one.
Vibes is the mobile engagement platform for brands and businesses looking for 
true long-term customer engagement
 and revenue from their mobile database, not merely short-term customer acquisition. 
Vibes is the best at both.
Ready for more foot traffic? SMS, RCS and Mobile Wallet marketing is what works.
Start uniting digital offers and your physical locations with the revenue-boosting, loyalty-driving combination of 
SMS, RCS
 and 
Mobile Wallet.
Vibes helps marketers create continuous customer engagement for better marketing, commerce, service and loyalty - all without the need for app downloads.
 It’s fully attributable,
 too, ensuring you’ve got top-tier measurement, targeting and ROI on every mobile campaign.

in North America. Our scalable infrastructure routed over

 in 2025 alone.

absolute

from businesses to the customers they're communicating with.

0%
 of our customers have cookie-cutter mobile programs.
That's because Vibes has an unparalleled strategic focus on helping our customers achieve long-term success, and why Vibes customers see 
25% lower SMS subscriber churn
 than those using competitive platforms.
There's no generic, ineffective batching-and-blasting with Vibes. We'll assign experts to help you build customized 
SMS
, 
MMS, RCS
 and 
Mobile Wallet 
marketing programs that exceed your goals and rapidly boost foot traffic.

Chipotle, Polo Ralph Lauren, Kohl's, 
and others use Vibes to deliver millions in revenue, with an average 90x ROI on Vibes-powered SMS messaging programs alone.

Get Started
Mobile-first marketing, built to boost your mobile revenues.
The Vibes mobile-first platform creates 
personal
, 
revenue-driving
 and 
long-term mobile engagement
 between consumers and the world-class brands they love.
You get 
all
 of it - 
SMS
, 
MMS
, 
RCS
, 
Mobile Wallet
 and 
Push
 - in one powerful platform.
Let's Talk
Trusted by Global Brands
and Industry Leaders
Launch your RCS program quickly with the leading mobile-first platform.
Now you can deliver communication and customer engagement experiences that go light years beyond what we’ve been used to with SMS and MMS. RCS merges 
the best of messaging & mobile apps
 into a single, powerful communication experience – and it’s already generating 3x engagement.
Get started with Vibes and 
do RCS the right way
, with direct carrier connections, no per-message markups, and 25+ years of deep mobile-first experience.
Learn More
Learn all about the Vibes platform in under 2 minutes.
SMS, RCS and Mobile Wallet together – the path to meaningful, attributable foot traffic.
Your customers aren’t looking for another email from you, and they’re probably not in your mobile app. But they’re definitely on their smartphones, and they love using the Apple and Google Wallet that’s native to their device for coupons, loyalty programs, tickets and gift cards.
‍
Marketers see 
19x more revenue per message
 from campaigns that use both SMS + Mobile Wallet, vs. those just sending SMS messages by themselves. The Vibes platform will bring them into your stores, restaurants and events.
SMS
RCS
Mobile Wallet
AI-powered intelligence, built on 25 years of messaging history & insights.
The Vibes platform supercharges your mobile campaigns with comprehensive analytics and 
automated, AI-powered marketing recommendations
, all with your best customer engagement and revenue results in mind.
‍
This is 
decision-ready data
 that helps optimize marketing outcomes for you, helping you deliver messaging at the right time, to the right segment and with the perfect content to capture the click.
Explore our Pricing
The fastest, most reliable and compliant SMS and RCS delivery.
Not all message routing is created equal. We should know.
‍
Vibes delivers industry-leading throughput and the absolute shortest message path from “sent” to “seen”. Thanks to our trusted, longtime direct connections with 
Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile 
and 65 other regional carriers across North America, you won't have to worry about messages that arrive late or not at all. 
Learn More about the Vibes Tier 1 advantage
Vibes has a relentless focus on our customers. Just ask our customers.
With 25+ years of leadership in mobile messaging, Vibes has helped to define, pioneer and evolve how 
SMS, RCS 
and
 Mobile Wallet 
marketing works seamlessly across North America’s brands and carriers. 
‍
This, combined with an unparalleled strategic focus on helping our customers achieve success - 
our NPS score is +75!
 - is why Vibes customers see 25% lower SMS subscriber churn than those using competitive platforms. 
Check out what our customers say about us on G2!
Learn more about our service & support
Vibes is beautifully integrated with the tools you’re 
already
 using.
There's no need to rip and replace anything. Vibes has a robust API suite, plus direct integrations into 
Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Marketo Engage, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Oracle CrowdTwist, Narvar, Snowflake
 and many more to ensure you maximize your technology investments.  
The Vibes integration layer makes it easy to bring enterprise-grade SMS, RCS, mobile wallet, advanced analytics and more into the tools you already use.

campaign customization that meets your unique objectives
, rather than templated, cookie-cutter experiences. 
Our flexible APIs let you bring 
enterprise-grade SMS, RCS, Mobile Wallet, advanced analytics
 and more into the tools your team relies upon, saving marketers time in building journeys, and allowing them to create 
thousands
 of different event triggers.

— all in one place. 
Now businesses can get full RCS functionality with just a credit card.

Create branded, interactive RCS flows
Route messages through carriers to create RCS experiences
Carrier costs absorbed by Vibes
RCS Studio is RCS simplified. You'll be sending your first message in 5 minutes.
Starting at $149/month

Get a Quote
Tier 1 SMS/MMS/RCS Aggregation
Use Vibes' fast, reliable and consistent Tier 1 SMS/MMS/RCS aggregation service and direct connections to North America’s carriers for your business.
Direct connections to Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile and over 65 regional carriers across North America
Messages delivered quickly, consistently and reliably across every single carrier, with geo-redundant data centers with active-active failover
Access to low-code APIs - easy to setup within 3 days
One central hub for short codes, toll-free, RCS and 10DLC
Dedicated Vibes Customer Success manager
Volume-based monthly pricing, typically 20%+ lower than alternatives
Get a Quote
Vibes has pricing plans that enable brands, businesses, cPaaS providers, messaging companies and others to build revenue-driving mobile engagement and to deliver high-speed, reliable and compliant messaging. 
We have two packages for the 
Vibes Platform
 (mobile-first messaging and engagement) and one package for 
Vibes Connect
 (A2P SMS, MMS and RCS connectivity). We also have multiple starting points for 
RCS Studio
, the only end-to-end platform that handles RCS agent creation, provisioning, compliance, and carrier delivery — all in one place.
And unlike other aggregators, we believe in
 full transparency of costs 
-
 
including clear delineation of what businesses are charged for, and which party is responsible for those charges. There are exclusive Carrier-based messaging fees that are paid by Vibes to the Carriers, and then billed to our customers as 
direct pass-through costs. 
Calculate estimated Carrier pass-through messaging fees with our 
Carrier Fee Calculator.
Get a Quote

Frequently Asked Questions
What type of businesses use Vibes?
Vibes works with ambitious brands and businesses looking to drive 
significant revenue from mobile
, and who want to go beyond simple cookie-cutter “mobile marketing” by instead pushing the envelope to build meaningful, long-lasting relationships with their customers. 
‍
This goes beyond just sending SMS messages - although that’s a start - but rather encompasses an 
intelligent suite of communication
 to customers, everywhere they can engage with your brand on their mobile devices. Vibes helps them manage SMS, MMS, RCS, mobile wallet, push notifications and appinboxes, all from a single platform. 
‍
We’ve found that retailers, restaurants, hospitality, entertainment/ticketing and automotive brands usually get the most value (revenue and customer engagement) out of the Vibes Platform. You can read some of our Customer Stories here, from brand names like 
Chipotle, Topgolf, Hibbett, Lids, Mattress Firm
 and more. 
‍
Our customers also have varying complexity in their marketing and technology stacks, from “fully homegrown” to those working with leading platforms such as Salesforce, Adobe Marketo Engage, Oracle CrowdTwist, Adobe Journey Optimizer and many others. We have a 
full API suite
 to help you ensure full campaign orchestration! 
‍
Vibes also works with a large variety of messaging resellers and digital native brands as a 
Tier 1 messaging aggregator
, to ensure that your text messages take the fastest path from you to consumers, without sending them through your competitors. Vibes is 1 of only 4 companies with direct connections to every US carrier. Our longtime relationships with 
Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile
 and 65 other regional carriers means we know everyone’s rules, and we bring the “one-stop-shop” experience to ensure that text campaigns run smoothly and correctly.
How much does Vibes cost?
We believe in simplicity, transparency and high value. Pricing for the Vibes Platform differs from what is typically offered by messaging companies. It’s 
much less complex
.
Rather than a monthly fee + an unpredictable “pay as you go” cost per message, we offer two simple tiers of an “all you can eat” bundled license, depending on your size and volume: 
Professional
 and 
Enterprise
, with Professional starting at $20,000. This provides you with everything in the Vibes platform: SMS, MMS, RCS, Mobile Wallet, and Push. You choose to turn on the parts that make sense for your business. 
Also - we don't charge anything on a per-message basis beyond what the mobile carriers charge us. No markups! 
Learn more here.
 
For 
Vibes Connect
/Tier 1 aggregation we charge on a per-message basis, which is typical for other SMS and CPaaS providers.
What is atypical in our approach is the level of hands-on service that we bring to our partners. Vibes provides our partners with the peace of mind that their messages are delivered quickly, consistently, reliably and at a fair price across every single carrier, with geo-redundant data centers with active
